prompt_text:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the beer can in <Picture 1>: a 500 ml aluminum beer can with a blue top and lid, a silver-white metallic body, small blue letters "BRAVE THE WORLD" near the top, large bold blue letters "SUPER DRY" across the middle and a red label block reading "SUPER DRY DRAFT BEER".

summary:
[reference generation] Over a young man's shoulder, a convenience-store refrigerator door opens to reveal a tidy display of <Subject 1> cans among other drinks, while his inner voice speaks off-screen.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the can's proportions, blue top, silver-white body, small "BRAVE THE WORLD" text, large bold blue "SUPER DRY" lettering and red "SUPER DRY DRAFT BEER" block are retained exactly on every can.

detailed_description:
The target video is a photorealistic premium television commercial filmed with a 35 mm lens, shallow depth of field and soft highlight roll-off, in clean cool-white light with crisp silver-blue highlights.
[Shot 1] An over-the-shoulder shot from behind a young man with natural short black hair and an unbuttoned dark blue-gray overshirt; the back of his head and his right shoulder are soft and out of focus in the left foreground. In front of him stands a tall convenience-store drinks refrigerator with a transparent glass door and bright white interior lights. His right hand takes the door handle and pulls the glass door open toward the camera, and a faint trace of cold mist drifts out and fades. Inside, on the middle shelf at eye level, a tidy row of six <Subject 1> cans stands upright in a neat line, all with their front labels facing the camera: blue tops, silver-white metallic bodies, small blue letters "BRAVE THE WORLD", large bold blue letters "SUPER DRY" and the red block "SUPER DRY DRAFT BEER", with fine condensation droplets on the cold metal. The cans are all identical and keep their shape. Beside the display, a plain silver-blue panel on the refrigerator wall carries no text. The shelves above and below hold other bottled drinks and other beers in assorted colors, softly out of focus, with indistinct labels. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed over his shoulder toward the row of cans, so the cans grow slightly larger and sharper. Cool light from the refrigerator rims his shoulder and hair. The young man (S1), in a clean, natural, slightly low-pitched male voice of a man in his late twenties, relaxed and reflective, says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[English] Then I thought...</d> while his lips remain completely closed. There is no other text anywhere in the frame.

overall_soundscape: The refrigerator door seal opens with a soft suction sound, the refrigeration hum grows slightly louder, and quiet store ambience continues behind it.

non_diegetic_music: Ambient electronic music at a slow tempo: sustained synth pads and a soft, steady low pulse with light, bright electronic plucks, rising slightly in volume but staying low.
